original_hypothesis: Two hypotheses, run in order. (i) THE REFUTATION IS CHEATING. RV-377-075's row may be smuggling charged computation into its description through a 256-entry exponent table that is not a registered kind and whose reads are charged one SEL each; or treating its log constants differently from the way dk_precision treats its probability constants; or undercharging the max-subtraction renormalization; or not actually operating at 8 bits; or leaking the truth into the served answer. If any of these lands, RV-377-075 is reversed and RV-377-066 is restored. (ii) IF IT IS NOT CHEATING, THE RESIDUAL IS A COST STATEMENT. The 8-bit log row is admissible but costs 3 104 description bits and 208 charged activations per query against 596 and 12 for the wider-instrument rows, so it should be dominated COORDINATE-WISE - more expensive on desc AND on every per-use coefficient - by the wider rows, and therefore occupy no cell of any cross-instrument frontier at any reuse horizon. Precision would then buy DESCRIPTION and EXECUTION COST, not capability.
minimal_proposed_change: DECLARED modules, both committed before this freeze, both importing RV-377-066's microscope, ecologies, event sequences, scoring rule, theta and cost model unchanged. (a) gmi_microscope/dk_precision_log_audit.py - the six-attack hostile audit of RV-377-075, EXECUTED BEFORE THIS FREEZE and committed in the preceding commit (receipt STAGE_DK_V4_LOGDOMAIN_AUDIT_V1.json). This is DISCLOSED, not glossed: clause 1 of this record is a REPRODUCTION clause, not a blind one, and it is labelled as such. (b) gmi_microscope/dk_precision_residual.py - the residual frontier and the sequence diagnostics, written before this freeze and NOT EXECUTED before it. It computes, on the combined thirteen-row portfolio (RV-377-066's ten linear rows plus RV-377-075's three log rows) at seven instruments (fx8, fx10, fx12, fx16, fx24, fx32, wide), two frontiers - PER-INSTRUMENT (protocol rule 17 as RV-377-066 ran it) and CROSS-INSTRUMENT (minimal cost over every admissible (row, instrument) pair) - under both declared price vectors and BOTH description bases, with gap DG-2 discharged in the only two ways it can be: a grid extended past TWICE every positive analytic crossover, and a COORDINATE-WISE DOMINATION theorem where no crossover exists. It also executes two FURTHER declared flip schedules, D (ambig 0, 11; noisy 2, 5, 10, 15, 20) and E (ambig 7, 20; noisy 4, 9, 13, 18, 23), written into the module before this freeze and never executed, as the split test RV-377-075 registered for its successor.
why_justified: protocol rule 19 (a verdict is valid only against a parent-maximal opponent) cuts both ways: RV-377-075 used it to refute RV-377-066, and it obliges this lane to attack RV-377-075 with the same hostility before building on it. Protocol rule 24, which RV-377-075 itself created, requires a gate claim to enumerate the representations of the carrier's state; the residual claim here is not a gate claim but a COST claim, and gap DG-2 requires that any 'no cell exists' clause be void if the grid stops before the crossover it denies.
new_prediction_before_outcome: (1) THE AUDIT [units: attacks; REPRODUCTION CLAUSE, executed before this freeze and disclosed]. All six attacks on RV-377-075 fail to reverse it: the table read is undercharged by a factor of 256 against the registered B0 emulation of S_LOOKUP (exec_q 208 -> 8 432) and the table description is understated by 514 bits against the store materialization basis, but capability is IDENTICAL under all six charging regimes; 0 of 1 056 log constants and 0 of 256 table entries per cell differ from an exact integer recomputation; the renormalization is charged 63 activations per event against a declared 63-64; 137 326 traced values at fx8 lie in exactly [-128, 127] with 0 escapes and 529 clamp events; 36 poisoned-truth re-runs give identical answer signatures; and RV-377-075's charged op sequence is DATA-DEPENDENT across instruments (3 290 043 against 3 289 787 at fx16) until its conditional division is repaired. (2) DOMINATION [units: cost coefficients]. On E_ambig, under the reduced price and the flat basis, LOGBAYES8@fx8 is dominated COORDINATE-WISE by QCOUNT@fx10 and by BAYESM@fx10 - desc 3 104 against 596, exec_q 208 against 12, and no smaller on upd, ver or rev - so NO positive analytic crossover exists between them in H or in r. (3) DG-2 IS DISCHARGED BY THEOREM, NOT BY GRID [units: pairs]. For every pair in which LOGBAYES8@fx8 appears against a wider-instrument admissible row on E_ambig, the receipt reports coordinate-wise domination and an EMPTY crossover, so the 'no cell' statement is a property of the affine cost function at every H >= 1 and r >= 0 and not a grid truncation; where any positive crossover does exist the grid extends past twice the largest of them. (4) CROSS-INSTRUMENT OCCUPANCY [units: frontier cells]. On E_ambig, in the cross-instrument frontier, LOGBAYES8@fx8 occupies 0 cells in all four (price, basis) keys, and the number of cells held by ANY fx8 row is also 0 in all four. (5) PER-INSTRUMENT OCCUPANCY [units: frontier cells]. On E_ambig at fx8 the admissible set is exactly (LOGBAYES8), so under protocol rule 17 at that instrument it occupies 100 % of the cells of all four keys - it is the occupant at fx8 only because it is the only admissible row there, which is a statement about an empty field and not about a frontier. (6) NECESSITY [units: cells]. There is NO cell in which a wider instrument is strictly NECESSARY for admissibility on E_ambig, because fx8 now has an admissible row; a wider instrument is strictly CHEAPER in every cross-instrument cell. The residual is therefore a COST statement and the capability axis is closed. (7) THE PRICE OF EIGHT BITS [units: description bits, charged activations per query]. desc(LOGBAYES8@fx8) / desc(QCOUNT@fx10) = 3 104 / 596 = 5.2081 under the flat basis; exec_q ratio = 208 / 12 = 17.3333 under the reduced price at RV-377-075's own `sel1` table charge, and 8 432 / 12 = 702.6667 under the registered B0 scan charge. (8) THE SCALED BASIS DOES NOT RESCUE IT [units: bits]. Under the `scaled` basis desc_scaled(LOGBAYES8@fx8) = 352*8 + 288 = 3 104 and desc_scaled(QCOUNT@fx10) = 36*10 + 308 = 668, a ratio of 4.6467; the domination and the 0-cell occupancy are unchanged. (9) BLIND CLAUSE - THE SPLIT TEST [units: sequences]. Declared sequences D and E are executed for the first time by this record. RV-377-075 registered the prediction that further sequences would 'split roughly as A and C did against B'. Predicted under test: the five ambiguous sequences A, B, C, D, E do NOT all agree - at least one of D, E is admissible at fx8 and at least one is not, OR the existing 2-1 split is preserved by both. Scored verbatim either way. (10) BLIND CLAUSE - SEPARATION [units: structural variables]. At least one CONCENTRATION variable of the exact posterior (support size, maximum posterior weight, participation ratio, top-4 mass, var q*) separates the admissible ambiguous sequences from the inadmissible ones across all five, and the flip-count-before-revocation variable of hypothesis H1 does NOT. If no variable separates, the sequence-B failure is UNEXPLAINED and is registered as such rather than narrated. (11) BLIND CLAUSE - THE NEGATIVE TWIN [units: sequences]. LOGBAYES8_NOMAXSUB scores exactly 0.0 at fx8 on all five ambiguous sequences including the two never executed, so the admissibility remains attributable to the log representation TOGETHER WITH its renormalization.
new_falsifier: (1) any of the six attacks changing the admissibility of LOGBAYES8 at fx8 on E_ambig sequence A, or any capability differing between two charging regimes, or any non-zero count of wrong constants, or any traced value outside the instrument range, or any poisoned-truth answer signature differing. (2) any coordinate of LOGBAYES8@fx8's per-event vector being strictly smaller than the corresponding coordinate of QCOUNT@fx10 or BAYESM@fx10 under the reduced price and flat basis. (3) any pair involving LOGBAYES8@fx8 on E_ambig reporting a positive crossover without the grid extending past twice it. (4) LOGBAYES8@fx8 occupying one or more cross-instrument cells in any of the four keys, or any fx8 row doing so. (5) the fx8 admissible set on E_ambig not being exactly (LOGBAYES8), or LOGBAYES8 not occupying every cell of the fx8 per-instrument frontier. (6) any cross-instrument cell whose occupant set is empty, which would mean no admissible row at any instrument. (7) or (8) any of the six ratios differing from the stated value. (9) the split test is scored verbatim and cannot be failed by its outcome; it FAILS only if either sequence errors or if the receipt does not report both. (10) no variable separating AND the record claiming an explanation anyway. (11) LOGBAYES8_NOMAXSUB scoring anything other than exactly 0.0 at fx8 on any of the five ambiguous sequences. TERMINAL FALSIFIER: the terminal must be exactly one of PRECISION_BUYS_DESCRIPTION_AND_EXECUTION_COST_NOT_CAPABILITY__AT_SCOPE, PRECISION_BUYS_NOTHING_ON_THIS_ECOLOGY, or PRECISION_BUYS_CAPABILITY__RV_377_075_REVERSED, and it is falsified if the receipt's own occupancy and admissibility fields do not entail it.
